basic_details.post_name: District Programme Manager-AYUSH, AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: National AYUSH Mission, Zilla Parishad Ratnagiri (National AYUSH Mission Ratnagiri), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 4 posts in 4 roles. The posts include District Programme Manager-AYUSH, AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Dietician. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online (PhonePe/GPay/UPI/Internet banking/Mobile banking) to SBI account no. 11149266074, District Integrated Health & family welfare Society Ratnagiri, IFSC SBIN0000467. Last date to pay the fee: 3 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years (as on the last date of acceptance of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: DPM-AYUSH: graduation in any discipline including AYUSH with MBA in Healthcare Management / Masters in health or hospital administration / 2-year PG diploma in Hospital & healthcare management plus 3 years public health experience; AYUSH MO (PG): MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/Panchakarma); Yoga and Naturopathy Expert: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM/Paramedical Council registration or M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietician: B.Sc Food & Nutrition/Home Science or PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science graduation

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduation degree in any discipline including AYUSH and MBA in Healthcare Management/Masters in health/hospital administration/Post Graduation diploma in Hospital & healthcare management (Two years) from AICTE recognized institute with minimum 3 years working experience in Public health programme. Experience required: Minimum 3 years working experience in public health Programme. Age limit: Minimum 18 years. Pay: Rs. 35,000. Qualification required: MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/ Panchakarma). Experience required: NIL. Age limit: Minimum 18 years. Pay: Rs. 60,000. Qualification required: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration/Paramedical Council registration; OR M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga. salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 60,000, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the attached format on A4 size white thick paper, on one side, typed or printed, in legible writing.
Write the post name and the unit/cell name on the envelope in bold letters.
Pay the fee online to SBI account 11149266074 (District Integrated Health & family welfare Society Ratnagiri, IFSC SBIN0000467) and write the UTI/UTR Transaction No. in the form.
Attach the online payment receipt and self-attested copies of mark sheets and certificates.
Deliver the application in person or by post to the District Health Officer office, Health Department, Zilla Parishad Ratnagiri by 03-12-2026 within office hours.
important_instructions: Experience will not be counted if the experience certificate is not attached Further recruitment notices will be published on https://ratnagiri.gov.in and https://zpratnagiri.gov.in; no separate correspondence Selection committee reserves the right to change the number of posts and the place of posting Chief Executive Officer reserves the right to postpone, cancel or change the recruitment process Semester-pattern candidates must write average marks in the form

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for National AYUSH Mission Ratnagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in National AYUSH Mission Ratnagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 District Programme Manager-AYUSH, 1 AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), 1 Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, 1 Dietician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for National AYUSH Mission Ratnagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format attached to the notice (pages 3-5); also published on https://ratnagiri.gov.in and https://zpratnagiri.gov.in) and send it to District Health Officer, Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Ratnagiri - 415 612, by by post or in person, to reach by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open category: Rs. 150 (non-refundable). Backward category: Rs. 100 (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on the last date of acceptance of applications). Relaxation: MBBS, specialist and super-specialist posts Maximum 70 years, Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, Technician, Counsellor, Pharmacist posts Maximum 65 years, Other posts - open category Maximum 38 years, Other posts - reserved category Maximum 43 years, Employees under National Health (as printed) 5 years relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 35,000 for District Programme Manager-AYUSH, Rs. 60,000 for AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Rs. 28000 or 20,000 for Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Rs. 20,000 for Dietician.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: DPM-AYUSH: graduation in any discipline including AYUSH with MBA in Healthcare Management / Masters in health or hospital administration / 2-year PG diploma in Hospital & healthcare management plus 3 years public health experience; AYUSH MO (PG): MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/Panchakarma); Yoga and Naturopathy Expert: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM/Paramedical Council registration or M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietician: B.Sc Food & Nutrition/Home Science or PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science graduation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be physically and mentally fit. Character certificate stating no criminal case is registered must be submitted within 1 month. Small family condition applies; small family declaration (Form A) must be submitted with the application.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not holding the prescribed eligibility. Candidates who bring recommendation or pressure for selection will be disqualified. Applications received by email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit-based selection by the District Level Recruitment Committee. Process to be carried out on merit, in a rational and transparent manner. List of eligible/ineligible candidates and selection list to be published on the NIC website of Ratnagiri.
